headline: A data centre being built in Lost Cabin, Wyoming, is only the first phase of a project that county commissioners put at $66 billion, and the county has little power to regulate it.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered to 5: the meeting was on Tue 6 Oct 2026, before the window, and the $66 billion figure comes from commissioners, not the company.
importance_line: Residents of Fremont County, who worry about land, water and wildlife, have little say because the county has no zoning, and the huge figure and the 500-megawatt power plan are not confirmed by the company in this report.
source: The Ranger (Riverton), as carried by WyomingNews.com
summary: The Ranger of Riverton, as carried by WyomingNews.com, reports that county commissioners said at a meeting on Tuesday 6 Oct 2026 that the data centre now being built at Lost Cabin is phase one of a $66 billion project, and that the planning director described plans for 500 megawatts of gas generators that would not feed the grid. Fremont County has no zoning rules, so it can do little to stop the project, though the larger plan would likely need approval from Wyoming's Industrial Siting Council; the developer, ETC DC OpCo, is linked to Aethel Energy and Electio Technologies, both backed by the venture capital firm General Catalyst.
notes: Read at wyomingnews.com (Laramie Boomerang site). The text credits 'The Ranger' as its own paper; the credit to The Ranger is inferred. Meeting date inferred as Tue 6 Oct 2026.
